items.q: No, but these guys were just free to do anything because they had been working with Lunceford's band for so long

ctx.x: Were many musicians practical jokers in those days?

No, but these guys were just free to do anything because they had been working with Lunceford's band for so long, and that alarm clock would go off at the most atrocious hour after a gig. The guys would be sleeping. Jack Carruthers did it. He was a real practical joker.
Were the guys in those periods -- did they read much? I don't mean music, but did many of the guys --
